briefdescription.para: Validate a plugin manifest and binary for load operations.

This function implements a 4-stage validation contract:
Manifest schema validation (required fields, types)
Manifest semantic validation (constraints, dependencies)
Signature verification (detached signature checks)
Capability validation (required capabilities available)
Fail-safe semantics: If any stage fails, the plugin remains in UNLOADED state and no partial activation occurs.

Path to the manifest file (for signature verification).
plugin_binary_path
Path to the plugin binary (for binary verification).
error_details
Output error description when validation fails.
PluginsError::kSuccess on success, or appropriate error code on failure.

briefdescription.para: Hot-reload a plugin without server restart (atomic with rollback).

detaileddescription.para: Reload Plugin.

Reload process:
Validate plugin is loaded; fail if dependents exist
Save IStatefulPlugin state (if applicable)
Verify new binary (hash + signature) — old plugin still running
Load new binary, create instance, initialize, restore state
If any of the above fail: return error, old plugin continues unaffected
Atomically swap old entry for new entry under mutex
Notify BEFORE_UNLOAD / AFTER_UNLOAD listeners
Shutdown and unload old binary (outside mutex)
Notify AFTER_LOAD listeners

name
Plugin name
Result<void> - success or error; old plugin remains running on failure
name
Input parameter.
Return value.
Calls: std::chrono::steady_clock::now(), lock(), find(), end(), ErrVoid(), fmt::format(), findDependentPlugins(), empty().

briefdescription.para: Check whether a loaded plugin has escalated its capabilities beyond what was declared in the manifest at load time.

detaileddescription.para: Check Capability Escalation.

The capabilities returned by the plugin's getCapabilities() are compared against the snapshot frozen at load time. If the current capabilities are a strict superset (i.e. any flag that was false at load is now true), the plugin is marked RESTRICTED and ERR_PLUGIN_CAPABILITY_ESCALATION is returned.
This method is a no-op on the hot call path: capabilities are only checked when this method is explicitly called (e.g. from a periodic security scan or after an explicit re-negotiation request).

simplesect.para: Ok(void) if no escalation is detected. Err(ERR_PLUGIN_CAPABILITY_ESCALATION) if escalation is detected; the plugin is also marked as RESTRICTED in the registry. Err(ERR_PLUGIN_NOT_FOUND) if the plugin is not loaded.
